database_summary: This is a sports event database (professional wrestling) capturing promotions, events (cards), locations, matches, wrestlers, belts (titles), match types, and scraped HTML tables. The central fact table is Matches (many rows per card). Cards link to Tables, Locations, Promotions and Events. Schema appears denormalized for some string FK columns (some FK columns are TEXT in Matches). Many rows (Matches ~540k) indicate event-history / event-measurements over time. Use caution: some columns (e.g. Matches.winner_id, loser_id, title_id, match_type_id) are stored as TEXT despite referencing integer ids, so referential integrity may be inconsistent. The dialect is SQLite.

accepted.name: matches_with_card_context
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Matches.id AS id,
  Matches.card_id AS card_id,
  Matches.winner_id AS winner_id,
  Matches.loser_id AS loser_id,
  Matches.win_type AS win_type,
  Matches.match_type_id AS match_type_id,
  Matches.duration AS duration,
  Matches.title_id AS title_id,
  Matches.title_change AS title_change,
  Cards.table_id AS table_id,
  Cards.location_id AS location_id,
  Cards.promotion_id AS promotion_id,
  Cards.event_date AS event_date,
  Cards.event_id AS event_id,
  Cards.url AS url,
  Cards.info_html AS info_html,
  Cards.match_html AS match_html,
  Promotions.id AS promotion_id__fk,
  Promotions.name AS name,
  Locations.id AS location_id__fk,
  Locations.name AS location_name,
  Events.id AS event_id__fk,
  Events.name AS event_name
FROM Matches
LEFT JOIN Cards ON Matches.card_id = Cards.id
LEFT JOIN Promotions ON Cards.promotion_id = Promotions.id
LEFT JOIN Locations ON Cards.location_id = Locations.id
LEFT JOIN Events ON Cards.event_id = Events.id
accepted.description: One-row-per-match enriched with its card, promotion, event, and location attributes. Useful as a base for most analytics that need match-level slices by date, promotion, event name, or location. | Use for: Count matches by promotion, location, or event over time; Filter matches by wrestler (winner_id/loser_id) and return card metadata; Analyze title changes per promotion or location

accepted.name: cards_with_promotion_and_location
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Cards.id AS id,
  Cards.table_id AS table_id,
  Cards.location_id AS location_id,
  Cards.promotion_id AS promotion_id,
  Cards.event_date AS event_date,
  Cards.event_id AS event_id,
  Cards.url AS url,
  Cards.info_html AS info_html,
  Cards.match_html AS match_html,
  Promotions.name AS promotion_name,
  Locations.name AS location_name,
  Events.name AS event_name,
  Tables.html AS table_html,
  Tables.url AS table_url
FROM Cards
LEFT JOIN Promotions ON Cards.promotion_id = Promotions.id
LEFT JOIN Locations ON Cards.location_id = Locations.id
LEFT JOIN Events ON Cards.event_id = Events.id
LEFT JOIN Tables ON Cards.table_id = Tables.id
accepted.description: One-row-per-card including promotion, location, and event names and the source table URL. Useful for card-level reports, time-series of shows, or joining back to matches for aggregated metrics. | Use for: List cards (shows) with promotion and location details; Find cards scraped from a particular source table URL; Aggregate number of cards per promotion or location over time

accepted.name: matches_with_wrestler_names
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.id AS id,
  m.card_id AS card_id,
  m.winner_id AS winner_id,
  w_winner.name AS winner_name,
  m.loser_id AS loser_id,
  w_loser.name AS loser_name,
  m.win_type AS win_type,
  m.match_type_id AS match_type_id,
  m.duration AS duration,
  m.title_id AS title_id,
  m.title_change AS title_change
FROM Matches AS m
LEFT JOIN Wrestlers AS w_winner ON CAST(m.winner_id AS TEXT) = CAST(w_winner.id AS TEXT)
LEFT JOIN Wrestlers AS w_loser ON CAST(m.loser_id AS TEXT) = CAST(w_loser.id AS TEXT)
accepted.description: Match-level rows with resolved winner and loser names from Wrestlers table. Useful when reporting match outcomes by wrestler name rather than id. | Use for: List matches with participant names; Filter matches by wrestler name; Compute per-wrestler win/loss counts

accepted.name: match_type_lookup
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Match_Types.id AS id,
  Match_Types.name AS name,
  CAST(Match_Types.id AS TEXT) AS match_type_id_text
FROM Match_Types
accepted.description: Normalized mapping of match_type_id to its descriptive name, preserving the match_type_id as stored in Matches. Useful to join into match-level datasets to expose human-readable match type. | Use for: Translate match_type_id in Matches to human-readable names; Group or filter matches by match type name

accepted.name: matches_enriched_with_match_type_name
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.id AS id,
  m.card_id AS card_id,
  m.winner_id AS winner_id,
  m.loser_id AS loser_id,
  m.win_type AS win_type,
  m.match_type_id AS match_type_id,
  mt.name AS match_type_name,
  m.duration AS duration,
  m.title_id AS title_id,
  m.title_change AS title_change
FROM Matches AS m
LEFT JOIN Match_Types AS mt ON CAST(m.match_type_id AS TEXT) = CAST(mt.id AS TEXT)
accepted.description: Matches joined to Match_Types to provide the descriptive match type name while preserving the original match_type_id. Useful for aggregations and filters by match type. | Use for: Count matches by match type name; Filter matches using descriptive match type

accepted.name: card_match_counts
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Matches.card_id AS card_id,
  COUNT(*) AS match_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Matches.title_change = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS title_change_count
FROM Matches
GROUP BY Matches.card_id
accepted.description: Aggregated counts of matches per card: total matches and number of title changes on the card. Useful for card-level summaries and merging with card metadata. | Use for: Which cards had the most matches; Which cards had title changes and how many

accepted.name: wrestler_aggregate_record
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  w_id AS wrestler_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN role = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN role = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses,
  SUM(1) AS matches
FROM (
  SELECT winner_id AS w_id, 'win' AS role FROM Matches
  UNION ALL
  SELECT loser_id AS w_id, 'loss' AS role FROM Matches
) AS pooled
GROUP BY w_id
accepted.description: Per-wrestler totals: matches won, matches lost, and total matches (as recorded in Matches). Uses winner_id and loser_id as recorded (TEXT) and preserves those ids for joins back to Wrestlers. | Use for: Leaderboards of wins/losses per wrestler; Compute win percentage (derived downstream) for each wrestler

accepted.name: cards_time_series
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS id,
  promotion_id AS promotion_id,
  event_date AS event_date,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promotion_id ORDER BY event_date DESC) AS rank_per_promotion
FROM Cards
accepted.description: Cards ordered by event_date per promotion, exposing a sequential rank_per_promotion. Useful to select the most recent N cards per promotion downstream by filtering on rank_per_promotion. | Use for: Get latest cards per promotion; Trend analysis of cards over time within a promotion

accepted.name: matches_duration_seconds
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS id,
  duration AS duration,
  CASE
    WHEN duration GLOB '*:*' THEN (
      (CAST(substr(duration, 1, instr(duration, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60)
      + CAST(substr(duration, instr(duration, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER)
    )
    ELSE NULL
  END AS duration_seconds
FROM Matches
accepted.description: Normalized match duration converted from MM:SS text to integer seconds where possible. Preserves original duration string. Useful for aggregations on match length and identifying unusually short/long matches. | Use for: Average/median match duration calculations; Filter matches by duration ranges
